_frozen: 2026-10-05, True, for Air's benches two and three (back-in-balance face; the medicine field). Each proposition says what its canonical line already entails and nothing more. Canonical lines kept beside each; parallel human-facing fields, not rewrites of canon.

readability-2026-10-05-B-1.canonical: Conceptual depth flows from genuine understanding — seeing patterns that liberate
readability-2026-10-05-B-1.plain: When this is working, you understand how things work because you really looked, and seeing the pattern sets you free rather than trapping you.

readability-2026-10-05-B-3.canonical: Release flows naturally from completion — surrender as fulfillment, not defeat (its parent Faith's balanced face, which this signature carries)
readability-2026-10-05-B-3.plain: When this is working, you let go of a thing because it is finished, and letting go feels like completing it, not like losing.

readability-2026-10-05-B-5.canonical: Breakthrough flows from genuine insight — structures fall that needed to fall (its parent Breakthrough's balanced face, which this signature carries)
readability-2026-10-05-B-5.plain: When this is working, what you have built comes down only when you have seen clearly that it needs to, and then it does.

readability-2026-10-05-B-7.canonical: Holding without forcing — capacity that contains rather than crushes (its parent Fortitude's balanced face, which this signature carries)
readability-2026-10-05-B-7.plain: When this is working, you can hold something steady without squeezing it; what you hold is kept safe, not crushed.

readability-2026-10-05-B-9.canonical: Recognition without finality — knowing that continues to deepen
readability-2026-10-05-B-9.plain: When this is working, you know something and stay open to knowing it better; nothing you understand is treated as the last word.

readability-2026-10-05-B-10.canonical: Direct knowing that proves accurate — comfort with not-knowing; perceptions land without argument (its parent Wisdom's balanced face, which this signature carries)
readability-2026-10-05-B-10.plain: When this is working, what you sense turns out to be right, you are at ease not knowing yet, and what you notice is taken as it is, without you having to argue for it.

1.canonical: GROWTH (Balanced): an invitation, optional by definition; what this balance is free to feed next.
1.plain: This is an invitation, not a fix: what this working part of you could feed next, if you want it to.

2.canonical: DIAGONAL (Too Much): the capacity in excess crosses the map to the opposite element; the medicine is the partner's own action.
2.plain: The way through is to do what this other capacity does. It is the opposite kind of thing from what you are doing too much of.

3.canonical: VERTICAL (Too Little): the seat is running on empty; the medicine is to charge its vertical twin — energy into the partner's own action pulls the current through the starved seat. Never push effort or feeling into the empty seat directly.
3.plain: The way through is not to push harder at the thing you are doing too little of. It is to do this other capacity's own action; doing that is what brings the first one back.

4.canonical: REDUCTION (Unacknowledged): authorship misattributed; the medicine returns toward the simpler, earlier form of the same line.
4.plain: The way through is a simpler, earlier version of the same thing you are already doing, done as your own.

readability-2026-10-05-B-1.what_canonical: Relational connection and alignment / The capacity to feel with rather than just about. Genuine alignment between beings that recognizes shared experience.
readability-2026-10-05-B-1.what_plain: Feeling with another person, not just about them: being with them in what they are going through.
readability-2026-10-05-B-1.face_canonical: Felt recognition that honors both self and other — connection without fusion
readability-2026-10-05-B-1.face_plain: Being close to someone while both of you stay yourselves.

readability-2026-10-05-B-2.what_canonical: Pure pattern, freed from literal / Recognition of pattern stripped of content… seeing how things work beneath surface appearance.
readability-2026-10-05-B-2.what_plain: Seeing how a thing works underneath what it looks like, apart from any one case.
readability-2026-10-05-B-2.face_canonical: Conceptual depth flows from genuine understanding — seeing patterns that liberate
readability-2026-10-05-B-2.face_plain: Understanding that comes from really looking, and that frees you rather than traps you.

readability-2026-10-05-B-3.what_canonical: Discipline-as-behavior: rigorous inquiry, method, embodied clarity. / The Judge — completing, embodying, governing through rigorous and disciplined clarity.
readability-2026-10-05-B-3.what_plain: Careful, methodical thinking done as a visible practice: following a method and seeing clearly because of it.
readability-2026-10-05-B-3.face_canonical: Practice flows without force — solitude connects rather than isolates; refinement serves growth, not anxiety
readability-2026-10-05-B-3.face_plain: Practising without strain; time alone that connects you rather than cuts you off; getting better at something because it helps you grow, not because you are anxious.

readability-2026-10-05-B-4.what_canonical: Decisive direction through aspiration. Choosing which star to steer by. / Inspiration gives aspirational pull — knowing which light to move toward.
readability-2026-10-05-B-4.what_plain: Choosing one direction because it is what you want to move toward, and going that way.
readability-2026-10-05-B-4.face_canonical: Radiance flows from genuine development — shining because what was cultivated reached completion
readability-2026-10-05-B-4.face_plain: What you give off comes from something you grew over time and brought to completion.

readability-2026-10-05-B-5.what_canonical: Gathered determination, harvested momentum. Defending chosen direction. / Resolve defends it against resistance (outer/gathering).
readability-2026-10-05-B-5.what_plain: Determination gathered up and used to defend the direction you chose when something pushes against it.
readability-2026-10-05-B-5.face_canonical: Movement from feeling — direction from genuine engagement
readability-2026-10-05-B-5.face_plain: Moving because you feel it; a direction that comes from being really involved.

readability-2026-10-05-B-6.what_canonical: Compassion-as-behavior: relational coherence, empathy, holding space for feeling. / The Empath — holding, maintaining, relating with deep emotional attunement and compassionate presence.
readability-2026-10-05-B-6.what_plain: Compassion as something you visibly do: staying in tune with people and making room for what they feel.
readability-2026-10-05-B-6.face_canonical: Felt recognition that honors both self and other — connection without fusion
readability-2026-10-05-B-6.face_plain: Being close to someone while both of you stay yourselves.

readability-2026-10-05-B-7.what_canonical: Faith-as-behavior: surrender, duty-bearing, knowing when to release as well as push. / The Commander — completing, embodying, governing with the authority that comes from knowing what to let go of.
readability-2026-10-05-B-7.what_plain: Carrying a duty and knowing when to let a thing go as well as when to push it.
readability-2026-10-05-B-7.face_canonical: Release flows naturally from completion — surrender as fulfillment, not defeat
readability-2026-10-05-B-7.face_plain: Letting go of a thing because it is finished, and feeling that as completing it, not losing.

readability-2026-10-05-B-8.what_canonical: Abundant growth achieved. Enjoying what careful tending produced. / Flourishing arrives at the abundant result of sustained tending (outer/abundant).
readability-2026-10-05-B-8.what_plain: Enjoying what your careful tending has grown.
readability-2026-10-05-B-8.face_canonical: Growth happening without forcing — care that doesn't exhaust; holding space without clutching
readability-2026-10-05-B-8.face_plain: Things growing without being forced; care that does not wear you out; making room for someone without gripping.

readability-2026-10-05-B-9.what_canonical: Pure possibility before differentiation / The seed state of all becoming. Not naivety but infinite potential — the moment before choice collapses possibility into actuality.
readability-2026-10-05-B-9.what_plain: Open possibility: the moment before you have decided what a thing is.
readability-2026-10-05-B-9.face_canonical: Pure presence — open, available, ready. Beginner's mind. Every moment fresh
readability-2026-10-05-B-9.face_plain: Being fully here, open and ready, meeting things as if for the first time.

readability-2026-10-05-B-10.what_canonical: Equity-as-behavior: fair emotional judgment, principled governance of feeling. / The Healer — completing, embodying, governing emotion with the authority of principled fairness.
readability-2026-10-05-B-10.what_plain: Judging feelings fairly, yours and other people's, by principle rather than by reaction.
readability-2026-10-05-B-10.face_canonical: Fairness flows naturally — clear sense of what's right without obsessive calculation; give and receive in flowing exchange
readability-2026-10-05-B-10.face_plain: A clear sense of what is fair without working it out obsessively; giving and receiving that balances on its own.
